jobPostingInfo.title: Engineering Manager
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.
 

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Manager, R&D to be a part of making this happen


Position Overview and Objective

At Arctic Wolf, our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead and mentor our UI engineering team building responsive, resilient, and intuitive interfaces across our security operations platforms. In this role, you will lead front-end (ReactJS ) execution while working hand-in-hand across technical boundaries—collaborating daily with Product Management, Backend/Platform (Go/Python), Quality Engineering, and DevOps/Cloud Foundations (AWS, Terraform, CI/CD) to deliver scalable, secure, end-to-end customer solutions. Familiarity with cybersecurity and Vulnerability Management / Exposure Management is essential, along with the ability to guide architecture, product roadmaps, and cross-functional collaboration across engineering and other functional areas.
 

Responsibilities
 

As a Manager at Arctic Wolf, you will:
 

  • Manage team(s) that will deliver high quality, innovative software solutions, in collaboration with stakeholders such as architects, developers, product managers, CSEs and prod support people.
  • Works with Product Team to define and deliver on the 3-month roadmap. 
  • Support the team by providing direction, clarity and removing obstacles.
  • Ensuring teams are highly motivated, performing well, and delivering work on time.
  • Remove any blockers preventing teams from getting their work done.
  • Making sure each team is clear on the objectives and goals they are striving to achieve.
  • Working with team members to deliver the key features.
  • Working with Architects to define and execute on the company's technical roadmap.
  • Establish career development plans and achievable goals for your reports and support their ongoing growth.
  • Develop and mentor careers of team members by executing regular one on ones, helping them grow their technical and leadership skills.
  • Drive continuous development process improvements.
  • Build collaborative relationships with other team
